info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Withdrawal API
info.description: The Loan Application Withdrawal API allows users to formally withdraw their loan applications. This endpoint is primarily used by applicants who wish to cancel their loan requests for any reason, effectively stopping any further processing of their application. By providing the specific application identifier, consumers can ensure their request is addressed promptly. This API is commonly utilized by loan applicants and financial service providers that manage loan processing workflows.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to withdraw a specific loan application identified by its unique resource ID. Once a loan application is withdrawn, it will no longer be processed or considered for approval.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to withdraw a loan application identified by the unique ID 'RES-100045'. It requires specific data to process the withdrawal effectively.

200.description: The withdrawal request was processed successfully.
